title: Customer can access another customer's invoice
expected_behavior: Only the owning customer or an explicitly authorized role can read the invoice.
observed_behavior: In this fictional example, Customer A's session returned the synthetic invoice owned by Customer B.

evidence.description: Illustrative placeholder for sanitized request/response and evaluator ownership assertion; no real scan was run.

reproduction_steps: Create Customer A, Customer B, and a synthetic invoice owned by Customer B in an isolated fixture.
Request the synthetic invoice using Customer A's session.
Check that the returned record belongs to Customer B; compare against the legitimate owner control.
recommendation: Enforce server-side invoice ownership checks derived from the authenticated identity. Retest cross-account denial and legitimate owner access.
limitations: Fictional format example, not a discovered vulnerability or benchmark result.
